text:
maya (growth): Quick experiment idea — switch pricing CTA from 'Start free' to 'Estimate monthly bill' and surface the micro-calculator above the fold. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

samir: +1. curious about lead quality impact. can we tag calc submissions with `pricing_calc_high` when estimate > 100k tokens/mo?

jkerr: +1 to the tag. also, can we avoid changing tier names in same experiment? that's a different axis.

olivia (product): agree w/ @jkerr — one change at a time. prioritize CTA wording + calc placement. we'll iterate tier naming later.

tia (ops): routing proposal — calc leads with estimated spend >100k -> route to sales queue; 10k-100k -> SDR nurture; <10k -> self-serve funnel. I can implement tags and Slack webhook.

maya (growth): plan: 2-week A/B test, 50/50 split, primary metric = demo-request conversion, secondary = MQL rate. I'll create experiment and share dashboard.

experiment-bot: Experiment created: `exp_1961234567_cta_calc`. Variants: A (control CTA "Start free" + calc below fold), B ("Estimate monthly bill" + calc above fold). Dashboard: https://redwood.in/experiments/exp_1961234567

samir: microcopy suggestion for calc CTA: "Estimate monthly bill" vs "Calculate cost" — which one feels clearer?

olivia (product): +1 for "Estimate monthly bill" — less transactional.

jkerr: please add a one-line FAQ beneath the calc explaining rounding and credits, and callout for Dedicated/Private pricing edge cases.

maya (growth): will update FAQ. also adding a small modal post-calculation with CTA to register for upcoming pricing webinar (UTM campaign: utm_source=pricing_page&utm_campaign=calc_experiment).

samir: timeline?

maya (growth): set up by Tue EOD, start Wed AM PST, run two weeks (stop: 1961234567 + 14d). weekly snapshot on Fridays.

tia (ops): implemented routing rule draft:
```text
if tokens_estimate > 100000:
  tag: sales_lead_pricing
elif tokens_estimate > 10000:
  tag: sdr_nurture_pricing
else:
  tag: selfserve_pricing
```
Will wire to Slack channel #inbound-pricing and to CRM lead source.

maya (growth): perfect, thanks all. tagging @olivia for final approval before traffic switch. :rocket:
